newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Nuclear 2 power plant trims output for work.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Nuclear 2 power plant trims output for work.

text.p: Electricity production at the Washington Nuclear 2 power plant (WNP-2) was trimmed over the weekend for inspection and replacement work on its feed pumps, the Nuclear Regulation Commission (NRC) said Monday.
Early today, the 1,158 megawatt (MW) generating station in Richland, Wash., was operating at 63 percent of capacity, compared with 100 percent Friday, NRC said.
WNP-2 is operated by Washington Public Power Supply System and owned by a consortium of public utilities in Washington.
